claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the powder as beautiful and love the results, especially the holographic/rainbow effect.
Many reviewers say a little powder goes a long way and the product is good value.
Reviewers commonly note it works best with gel polish and a no-wipe top coat, and some say curing longer or using an LED/UV lamp improves results.
Several reviewers say it can be tricky and that following directions or using proper technique is important, attributing failures to user error.
A few reviewers mention negatives: difficulty removing it and disappointment with the color received versus the photos.
